subject: Stellarsys MAP: draft, exec pricing approval & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Claire Thompson <claire@stellarsys.com>, Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@stellarsys.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-15T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Stellarsys MAP: draft, exec pricing approval & next steps

Hi Claire / Tom —

Great to connect today. Quick recap and a draft Mutual Action Plan (attached) to keep everyone aligned on milestones, owners, and the target close date. Please review and let me know any edits.

Key highlights from the call:
- Goal: Production rollout of Redwood inference for customer support routing by Q3 (pilot -> prod).
- Target close date: 2026-06-30 (Stellarsys exec review + procurement sign-off).
- Primary blockers: procurement review of pricing/credits, SOC2 evidence for security team, and final commit level from finance.

Draft MAP (attached spreadsheet):
1) Pilot kickoff (Redwood SE + Stellarsys SRE) — target: 2026-06-22 — owner: Stellarsys
2) Security questionnaire & evidence handoff — target: 2026-06-18 — owner: Redwood (Nikhil)
3) Exec pricing review & approval (discount / credits / commit) — target: 2026-06-24 — owner: Stellarsys execs + Redwood sales leadership
4) Procurement & contract signature (DocuSign) — target: 2026-06-30 — owner: Stellarsys procurement
5) Production cutover & onboarding — target: 2026-07-15 — owner: Joint

Pricing note: per our call you requested a seat-based commit with a potential introductory credit applied to first month. I flagged a possible 15% introductory discount + $15k onboarding credit as a negotiation starting point, pending exec approval. If you can share the preferred commit level (monthly vs annual / $ commit) that helps finalize the numbers.

Attachments: Stellarsys-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones), Redwood-Proposal-Stellarsys.pdf (proposal & pricing).

Next steps I propose:
- Claire: confirm MAP owners and whether 6/30 target is acceptable
- Tom/Procurement: share any legal/contract constraints that would change the timeline
- I will loop in our revenue lead and my manager for the exec pricing review once you confirm the MAP and commit level

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the line.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0124

From: Claire Thompson <claire@stellarsys.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@stellarsys.com>, procurement@stellarsys.com
Date: 2026-06-16T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Stellarsys MAP: draft, exec pricing approval & next steps

Thanks Marissa — really appreciated the concise MAP. A few quick items from our side:

- Target close: 6/30 is aggressive but doable if execs see a clean MAP and a firm commit level. Our CFO would prefer an annual commit for better economics; I can confirm $ commit range today (likely in the $200k–$300k ARR neighborhood).
- Procurement: looping them in (procurement@stellarsys.com). They’ll need the final SOW and payment terms — DocuSign OK.
- Security: our security lead will send a short list (SOC2 questions) to Nikhil — should be straightforward.

On discounts/credits: the CFO asked if we can get a one-time implementation credit and an introductory discount on the first 3 months. If you can propose exact numbers in the MAP (e.g., 15% discount + $15k credit), that will make exec review faster.

Happy to join a 30 min alignment call if that helps expedite.

Best,
Claire
Head of Product, Stellarsys
claire@stellarsys.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Stellarsys MAP: draft, exec pricing approval & next steps

Lauren / Nikhil — forwarding Claire’s reply. They sound ready to move quickly if we can land exec approval on a modest discount + credit. Key asks: 1) confirm 15% introductory discount + $15k onboarding credit as an option we can offer, 2) confirm that an annual commit in the $200k–$300k ARR range is eligible for additional volume discounts, and 3) confirm any SLA/credit constraints for Dedicated deployment.

Suggested internal approach:
- Offer: 15% off list for first 3 months + $15k one-time onboarding credit if they commit to annual $225k ARR (midpoint).
- Alternative: if they only want monthly commit, reduce credit to $7.5k and offer 10% introductory discount.

I’ve attached the proposal and MAP. Once we have a thumbs up from revenue/you I’ll present to their CFO + procurement (quick call).
\Deal ID: STELL-4872. HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567

Thanks —
Marissa

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Stellarsys MAP: draft, exec pricing approval & next steps

Marissa — thanks for the heads up. I’m okay to provisionally approve the outlined pricing levers so we can move fast. A few ask items before I give final sign-off:

- Please add rationale (customer stage, ARR target, strategic value) to the MAP so revenue/finance can see the context.
- Confirm expected ACV impact and payback timeline in the proposal doc (simple line items are fine).
- Any required legal exceptions (custom payment terms, indemnity) should be flagged now so legal can triage.

If you can update the MAP with those notes I’ll escalate for final exec approval. Otherwise the 15%/ $15k onboarding credit tied to $225k annual commit is acceptable as a starting offer.
—Lauren
VP Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

\Next step to keep timeline: can we schedule a 30-min call with your CFO + procurement for Wednesday 6/17 at 10am PT or Thursday 6/18 at 11am PT? If you confirm a preferred slot I’ll send a calendar invite and a short one-pager showing ACV impact for execs.
\I’ll also update the MAP with the rationale and expected ACV impact per Lauren’s note and push to HubSpot. DocuSign link will be prepared once we agree final terms.
\Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.
